main_text.l: Ad adducendum, Dan.5.7: & לְהַעֲלָה Ad-ducere, Dan. 4.3. Hophal הָעַל Adductus, Introductus est, Dan.5.13: הָעֲלוּ Introducti funt, Dan.5.15.
מַעֲלִי m. Chald. Accessus, Ingressus, Occasus, Dan.6.14.
עלם Niphal נֶעְלַם Latitare, Abdere, Abscon-dere, Abditum Occultum esse: Hiphil הֶעְלִים Abdidit, abscondit, Celavit, Occul-tavit. Hithpahel הִתְעַלֵּם, Abscondit, Occultavit se.
עַלְמָה f. Adolescentula, Puella, Virgo: plur. עֲלָמוֹת, quod & instrumenti musici nomen, aut initium carminis olim noti & usitati, Psal.46.1.1.Chron.15.20.
עָלְמָא עָלַם m. Chald. Idem: plur. לְעָלְמִין In secula, Dan. 5.10: & לְעָלְמַיָּא Dan. 2.44.
